name: Admin Proposal Edit
description: Edit an existing business proposal through General, Propuesta, Comunicación, Documentos, Proyecto and Seguimiento, with visible secondary navigation and status-gated destinations. Documentos remains available in every proposal state, including draft and finished. Legacy tab links resolve to the corresponding group and section; navigation retains unsaved editors and selected video files, loads panels on first visit and preserves unrelated URL parameters and fragments. Includes Propuesta → Detalle técnico where each requirement can be linked to commercial items (linked_item_ids checkboxes) for item-requirement traceability. The technical editor renders its sections collapsed by default (headers with counts; bodies mount on expand via technical-section-toggle-<key>) and the per-requirement link grids live behind a 'Vincular alcance/ítems' disclosure (technical-req-links-toggle); the JSON sub-tab mounts only when opened. Proyecto > Datos está disponible en todos los estados y conserva el vínculo del cliente; contactos y ajustes de Comunicación > Correos guardan de forma independiente del borrador de General. Recursos pertenece a Propuesta. Los enlaces antiguos Comunicación/Recursos se redirigen a esa subpestaña sin perder otros parámetros.
knownGaps: Automations toggle switched to positive polarity (ON = automations running, 2026-07); knob position/aria-checked not asserted and the toggle lacks a data-testid.
